population.definition: Original main-source episodes whose actions were generated by make_windy_teacher; uniform coverage and the separately collected blind demonstrator are excluded from the nominal expert policy.

appended_blind_demonstrator.purpose: separate causal-support source; retained in the full dataset but excluded from nominal imitation

uniform_coverage.purpose: coverage, not output of the nominal teacher

population.selection_predicate: original_episode_id in [1200, 6000); source bounds are verified against teacher_mode codes but labels are not inputs
